تستخلبون (form X)
# تَسْتَخْلِبُونَ (tastaḵlibūna) /tas.tax.li.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# تُسْتَخْلَبُونَ (tustaḵlabūna) /tus.tax.la.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
